name: Aegis
concise_description: Enchantment Spell. Enchants all party members within earshot ({{Duration}} seconds). 50% chance to block.

name: Aegis (PvP)
concise_description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds). Target party member cannot be targeted by hostile spells. Attacks against this party member fail. Cannot self-target.

name: Air of Enchantment
concise_description: Elite Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Enchantments cast on target ally cost 5 less Energy (minimum 1 Energy). Cannot self-target.

name: Amity
concise_description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Foes adjacent to you cannot attack. Ends on any foes that take damage.

name: Aura of Faith
concise_description: Elite Enchantment Spell. (3 seconds.) Target ally gains {{PercentExtraHealing}}% more Health when healed and takes {{PercentLessDamage}}% less damage.

name: Aura of Stability
concise_description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Target ally cannot be knocked-down. Cannot self-target.

name: Balthazar's Aura
concise_description: Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) Deals {{HolyDamage}} holy damage each second to foes adjacent to target ally.

name: Balthazar's Pendulum
concise_description: Elite Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) Causes knock-down to the next foe attempting to knock-down target ally.

name: Balthazar's Spirit
concise_description: Enchantment Spell. Target ally gains adrenaline and 1 Energy when taking damage.

name: Bane Signet
concise_description: Signet. Deals {{HolyDamage}} holy damage. Causes knock-down if target foe is attacking.

name: Banish
concise_description: Spell. Deals {{HolyDamage}} holy damage. Deals double damage to summoned creatures.

name: Blessed Aura
concise_description: Enchantment Spell. Monk enchantments you cast last {{PercentLongerDuration}}% longer.

name: Blessed Light
concise_description: Elite Spell. Heals for {{Healing}}. Removes one condition and one hex.

name: Blessed Signet
concise_description: Signet. You gain 3 Energy for each enchantment you are maintaining. You cannot gain more than {{Energy}} Energy in this way.

name: Boon Signet
concise_description: Elite Signet. Heals for {{Healing}}. Your next Healing or Protection Prayer [sic] spell that targets an ally heals for +{{HealingOnNextSpell}} Health.

name: Castigation Signet
concise_description: Signet. Deals {{HolyDamage}} holy damage. You gain {{EnergyGain}} Energy if target foe is attacking.

name: Contemplation of Purity
concise_description: Skill. You gain {{HealthGain}} Health and lose one hex and one condition for each enchantment on you (maximum {{MaximumLost}} hexes and conditions). You lose all enchantments.

name: Convert Hexes

name: Cure Hex
concise_description: Spell. Removes a Hex. Removal effect: Heals for {{Healing}}.

concise_description: Elite Hex Spell. ({{Duration}} seconds.) You gain 2 Energy whenever target foe hits with an attack.

name: Dismiss Condition
concise_description: Spell. Removes one condition. Heals for {{Healing}} if target ally is enchanted.

name: Divert Hexes
concise_description: Elite Spell. Removes {{HexesRemoved}} hex[es]. For each hex removed, target ally loses one condition and gains {{HealthGain}} Health.

name: Divine Healing
concise_description: Spell. Heals you and party members within earshot for {{Healing}}.

concise_description: Enchantment Spell. ({{Duration}} second[s].) Monk spells cost you 5 less Energy. Minimum cost: 1 Energy.

name: Draw Conditions

name: Dwayna's Kiss
concise_description: Spell. Heals for {{Healing}}. Heals for {{AdditionalHealing}} more for each enchantment and hex on target ally. Cannot self-target.

name: Empathic Removal

name: Ethereal Light
concise_description: Spell. Heals for {{Healing}}. Easily interrupted.

concise_description: Elite Spell. Heals for {{Healing}}.

concise_description: Spell. Heals for {{Healing}}. Cannot self-target.

concise_description: Elite Enchantment Spell. (10 seconds.) Heals for {{HealthGain}} whenever target takes damage.

concise_description: Spell. Heals you and party members within earshot for {{Healing}} points.

concise_description: Spell. Heals for {{Healing}}. Cannot self-target.

concise_description: Spell. Heals for {{Healing}}.

name: Shield of Regeneration

concise_description: Enchantment Spell. (8 seconds.) Reduces incoming damage and life steal by {{DamageReduction}}. End effect: heals for {{Healing}}

concise_description: Signet. Heals for {{Healing}}.

concise_description: Elite Signet. Removes one hex and one condition. No effect unless target ally is enchanted.
